mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_family_member ( family_id, member_email, family_role, parent_type ) VALUES ( #{familyId}, #{memberEmail}, #{familyRole}, #{parentType} )
mapper.select: SELECT family_id, family_name, invite_code, created_by, created_at FROM tbl_family WHERE invite_code = #{inviteCode}
SELECT f.family_id, f.family_name, f.invite_code, f.created_by, f.created_at FROM tbl_family f INNER JOIN tbl_family_member fm ON fm.family_id = f.family_id WHERE fm.member_email = #{memberEmail}
SELECT id, family_id, member_email, family_role, parent_type, joined_at FROM tbl_family_member WHERE member_email = #{memberEmail}

SELECT fm.id, fm.family_id AS familyId, fm.member_email AS memberEmail, m.nickname AS nickname, fm.family_role AS familyRole, fm.parent_type AS parentType, fm.joined_at AS joinedAt FROM tbl_family_member fm INNER JOIN tbl_member m ON m.email = fm.member_email WHERE fm.family_id = #{familyId} ORDER BY fm.joined_at ASC
